recognize_zh: 黏液胭脂紅（mucicarmine）染色下，細胞被黃褐色對比染色，視野上方與右側可見成群的小圓形菌體呈淡色、未被染成紅色，表示菌體沒有黏多醣莢膜，可用來排除隱球菌（Cryptococcus）。
features: Mucicarmine-stained section with yellow-brown counterstain throughout cells and stroma
Small clusters of tiny round, pale, refractile organisms without red capsular staining (upper centre and right)
No carmine-red capsular material around organisms anywhere in the field
Background densely packed hematopoietic and histiocytic cells with brown-stained nuclei and cytoplasm
Occasional yellow refractile bodies/pigment, likely non-specific
describe_en: Mucicarmine-stained section shows cellular tissue with a yellow-brown counterstain. Small clusters of tiny, round, pale organisms are present, and none show carmine-red staining of a capsule. The negative mucicarmine reaction argues against Cryptococcus, whose polysaccharide capsule is mucicarmine positive. In context with GMS- and PAS-positive small yeasts, findings support Histoplasma capsulatum.

ddx.vs: Cryptococcal yeasts are larger (4-10 um) with a thick capsule that stains red with mucicarmine, whereas these organisms are unstained.
Blastomyces is larger (8-15 um) with a thick refractile wall and broad-based budding and may show weak mucicarmine cell-wall staining, unlike these tiny yeasts.
Rhinosporidium forms very large sporangia containing mucicarmine-positive endospores, which are far larger than the organisms here.
